question: On their mother's side, the Mughals were descendants of which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genghis Khan**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The Mughals were descendants of **Genghis Khan** through their maternal lineage. Genghis Khan, the founder of the Mongol Empire, is regarded as one of the most powerful rulers in history.

• The Mughal dynasty's founder, **Babur**, traced his lineage from Genghis Khan through his mother, Qutlugh Nigar Khanum, who was a descendant of the Mongol ruler.

• Although the Mughals were descended from Genghis Khan, they distanced themselves from this ancestry because Genghis Khan was associated with the devastation of Islamic lands.

• On their paternal side, the Mughals were descendants of **Timur**, a Turco-Mongol conqueror who established the Timurid dynasty. Thus, the Mughals combined both Mongol and Timurid heritage.
